posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: So now we have a pretty good idea of the premise of the RPG: The PC's are mentees of an existing hero team (or perhaps represent different teams).  Both Dark Watch and the Freedom Five take on "apprentice" heroes.  I'm sure the Prime Wardens do as well.  Void Guard... possibly.  Idealist and Wraith aren't really the mentor types, but on the other hand, the Obliveon Shards are probably destroyed at that point, leaving the team significantly weakened.
